display_long_description:
Welcome to Jannaty
Jannaty (جنتي – “My Paradise”) is an Islamic app designed to help you access useful Islamic knowledge and daily worship tools in one place. The app focuses on learning, remembrance, and organization, using technology in a simple and respectful way.
WHAT YOU CAN FIND IN THE APP
DAILY WORSHIP TOOLS
Prayer times with calculation options and notifications
Adhkar collections (morning, evening, sleep, and daily supplications)
Tasbih counter with basic tracking
Zakat calculator for general estimation
QURAN FEATURES
Quran text with available tafsir sources
Audio recitations by different reciters
Translations with synchronized audio
Bookmarks to save verses
ISLAMIC KNOWLEDGE CONTENT
Hadith collections from well-known sources
Seerah of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)
Stories of Prophets mentioned in the Quran
99 Names of Allah with meanings
Selected Islamic books (fiqh, aqeedah, spirituality)
LEARNING FEATURES
Islamic lessons for different levels
Daily reminders for learning and worship
Family profiles to organize individual progress
Simple progress overview
APP HIGHLIGHTS
Authentic Sources
Content is based on recognized Islamic references.
For Different Users
Suitable for beginners and learners at different stages.
Offline Access
Many features can be used without an internet connection.
Privacy Respect
User data is handled with care and not shared unnecessarily.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
Custom reminders
Personal dashboard
Multiple language support
Night mode
Bookmark synchroniza
